technicalRecommendations.hooks: Focus on immediately grabbing attention with a surprising statement, a question, or a visual element that creates intrigue. Use a 'you' focus to speak directly to the viewer's needs or desires. Test different hook styles and analyze which ones perform best.
technicalRecommendations.titles: Use keywords that people are searching for, but also make the title intriguing and click-worthy. Numbers, questions, and strong adjectives (e.g., shocking, secret) can be effective. Keep titles concise and mobile-friendly.
technicalRecommendations.postingSchedule: Maintain a consistent posting schedule, even if it's just one video per day. Experiment with different posting times to see when your audience is most active. Consistency is key for building momentum and training the algorithm.
technicalRecommendations.hashtags: Use a mix of broad and niche-specific hashtags. Research trending hashtags relevant to your content. Avoid using too many hashtags, as it can appear spammy. Focus on quality over quantity. #shorts is a must.

technicalRecommendations.postingSchedule: Experiment with posting times to identify when your audience is most active. Consistency is key. Aim for at least 1-3 videos per day, but don't sacrifice quality for quantity.
technicalRecommendations.hashtags: Use a mix of broad and niche-specific hashtags. Research trending hashtags relevant to your content. Don't overuse hashtags; focus on quality over quantity (3-5 relevant hashtags per video).
